dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: I'm sure you've been enjoying all that Liyue Harbor has to offer?

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: As a native of Snezhnaya, I was initially quite reluctant about being transferred to Liyue by the Northland Bank.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: But as I came to understand more about Liyue, I found myself liking it more and more.

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: Things like the sea here and the city's atmosphere are all quite different from my home, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: My hometown is not quite as lively as the bustling city of Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: And I've completely fallen in love with the food in Liyue. With such a variety of colors, flavors, and aromas, the cuisine here is simply exquisite!

dialogues.speaker: Andrei
dialogues.text: But even so, I could never turn my back on Her Majesty the Tsaritsa of Snezhnaya.
